name: vora-web
description: VORA Websites — production web platform (public site, admin, client and member portals, VORA AI) on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e:browsers: E2E_BROWSERS=all playwright test --project=webkit --project=mobile-webkit && E2E_BROWSERS=all playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.e2e:prepare: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state .wrangler/e2e-setup-state .wrangler/e2e-setup-nojs-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && tsx scripts/seed.ts --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && tsx scripts/dev-users.ts --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --out .wrangler/e2e-state/users.json && tsx scripts/dev-users.ts --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --set sec --out .wrangler/e2e-state/users-sec.json && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-setup-state && tsx scripts/seed.ts --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-setup-state && cp -R .wrangler/e2e-setup-state .wrangler/e2e-setup-nojs-state
scripts.e2e:server: npm run e2e:prepare && react-router build && node scripts/e2e-secrets.mjs && node scripts/e2e-servers.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/confirm.mjs "Apply migrations to PRODUCTION" && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:production: node scripts/confirm.mjs "Seed PRODUCTION base data" && tsx scripts/seed.ts --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging react-router build && npm run security:scan && tsx scripts/predeploy-check.ts --env staging && wrangler deploy --experimental-provision=false
scripts.deploy:staging:dry-run: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging react-router build && npm run security:scan && tsx scripts/predeploy-check.ts --env staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --experimental-provision=false
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/confirm.mjs "Deploy to PRODUCTION" && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production react-router build && npm run security:scan && tsx scripts/predeploy-check.ts --env production && wrangler deploy --experimental-provision=false
scripts.deploy:production:dry-run: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production react-router build && npm run security:scan && tsx scripts/predeploy-check.ts --env production && wrangler deploy --dry-run --experimental-provision=false
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
